source: Live answers from api.routescan.io to a fetch() GET getsourcecode run in a page served from http://127.0.0.1:<port> in Chromium 148.0.7778.96 (Playwright, headless), recorded 2026-11-05T19:35:04.606Z: once with no key, once with a registered free-plan key, shown as [redacted] in the apikey header, and once with a made-up key in that header.
